newsitem.title: USA: McDonnell Douglas insiders sold shrs early - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: McDonnell Douglas insiders sold shrs early - WSJ.

text.p: Four McDonnell Douglas executives and a former executive sold $1.48 million of stock in October, missing the chance to make an additional $250,000 since Boeing announced plans to buy the firm, The Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday.

"They bailed out way too soon," David Coleman, editor of Vicker's Weekly Insider Report newsletter, told the newspaper. It was the biggest cluster of sales by McDonnell Douglas officials in more than a decade, the newspaper said.
Coleman, who tracks insider trading patterns for clues to a company's outlook, noted that insiders chose to cut their holdings just as a spate of bad news began to hit the company.

The early sellers cited in the story are Walter Orlowski, vice president and general manager of Douglas Aircraft Co; John Van Gels, a Douglas Aircraft vice president; William Austin, vice president and general manager of McDonnell Douglas Aerospace; Roger Krone, vice president and treasurer; and former vice president Robert Trice.
